strongest_findings.finding: Executable cache policy has four warm slots and no overflow lane, while older prose still promises an overflow directory.
strongest_findings.action: Make the wrapper and cargo-cache.md authoritative; remove stale overflow wording before granting build lanes.

strongest_findings.finding: Code declares ten required viewport sizes while the GUI document says nine.
strongest_findings.action: Version one matrix and validate it across manifest, planner, reports, and gates.

strongest_findings.finding: IME steps are accepted but dispatch no event.
strongest_findings.action: Implement native dispatch or fail explicitly and add platform coverage.

strongest_findings.finding: NativeAccessKit is declared but current evidence is GPUI post-layout metadata and measured rectangles.
strongest_findings.action: Add native tree readback or narrow the product claim.

strongest_findings.finding: Restart journeys are broad, but local persistence lacks explicit corrupt/future-version/interrupted-write cases.
strongest_findings.action: Add a versioned file compatibility and corruption matrix.

strongest_findings.finding: Windows has native seam tests; Unix re-exports standard types and repository platform execution is not codified for Linux/macOS/Windows.
strongest_findings.action: Require actual OS lanes for process and GUI seams.

strongest_findings.finding: Flow/store/version root models overlap across unit, law, and performance suites.
strongest_findings.action: Create one registrar-owned model/corpus and keep performance assertions separate.

strongest_findings.finding: Multiple process matrix launchers and parity helpers define overlapping semantics.
strongest_findings.action: Centralize case vocabulary and assign parity/lifecycle owners.

dan_luu_sources.title: How well do agents use test/verification techniques?
dan_luu_sources.principle: Named techniques are often applied superficially; use structured generators, independent oracles, mutation, and holdouts; avoid strong ordering claims.

dan_luu_sources.title: Agentic test processes, LLM benchmarks, and other notes on agentic coding from Galapagos Island
dan_luu_sources.principle: Risk-directed randomized testing, independent artifact review, and bounded review setup reduce false positives.

dan_luu_sources.title: Bad benchmarks and evals: Senior SWE-Bench, napkin math, and winter tires
dan_luu_sources.principle: Representativeness and sample size affect benchmark conclusions.

dan_luu_sources.title: The benchmarkpocalypse
dan_luu_sources.principle: Visible suites invite reward hacking; hidden holdouts expose overfit.

dan_luu_sources.title: How does programming language affect token efficiency and correctness?
dan_luu_sources.principle: Visible-test success can be brittle; holdout evaluation changes generalization.

dan_luu_sources.title: There's no reason for software to be slow anymore
dan_luu_sources.principle: Bounded optimization can overfit; representative holdout workloads are required.

dan_luu_sources.title: Bug blindness
dan_luu_sources.principle: Experts internalize workarounds; fresh-user journeys find hidden defects.

dan_luu_sources.title: Given that we spend little effort on testing, how should we test software?
dan_luu_sources.principle: Randomized and coverage-guided testing can find rare paths; line coverage is insufficient.

dan_luu_sources.title: Reading postmortems
dan_luu_sources.principle: Error handling and cascades need direct tests and analysis.

dan_luu_sources.title: Measurement, benchmarking, and data analysis are underrated
dan_luu_sources.principle: Measurement is engineering work when paired with a sound question and oracle.

dan_luu_sources.title: How often is the build broken?
dan_luu_sources.principle: Clean-build reliability matters; samples and configuration affect comparability.
